entities.summary: Al-Muhdar Mosque or Al-Mihdar Mosque is one of the historical mosques in the ancient city of Tarim, in the Yemeni province of Hadramaut. It is attributed to Omar Al-Mihdar bin Abdul-Rahman Al-Saqqaf, a Muslim leader who lived in the city during the 15th-century.
